rules.sentence: LVEF <35% at the time of diagnosis absence of other identifiable causes of cardiomyopathy; and

As the presence of typical LBBB in patients with HF translates into superior haemodynamic response to CRT, strict criteria including the duration of LBBB to categorise them as LIC would result in underestimation of the true prevalence.
Rather, a broad terminology LB-NICM obviating the duration of LBBB and baseline LVEF at the time of diagnosis of LBBB would help in identifying the potentially reversible form of HF patients.
